The approvals inbox now carries its state in the address and every write replaces the history entry, so Back and reload return to where the reader left off. That state is the tab (as `scope`, since `tab` is the console's reserved record-page param), plus status, process, object, search (`q`, debounced 350 ms) and sort. Defaults are left out of the address, and unknown values read as defaults.

A process or object no loaded row carries is dropped only when the loaded rows are the whole answer. On the paginated tabs it is kept and shown in its dropdown. `?request=` deep links are unchanged.

Carry-over, noted not filed: the process and object selects draw only with two or more options among the loaded rows.

`pm:dispatched` removed.
